Class PresetControlBar<T>

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
org.ether.society.ui.PresetControlBar<T>
Type Parameters:
T - Preset type
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class PresetControlBar<T> extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Standardized Preset Toolbar with inline editable name field. Behaviour: - Starts empty (no preset selected by default). - Selecting a preset from the ComboBox populates the name field. - If the user modifies any parameter (notified via notifyParametersChanged()), the name field is cleared to signal an unsaved custom state. - The name field is always directly editable (user can type a new name or rename). - Saving uses the text currently in the name field. - Renaming an existing preset: edit the name field + Save → updates the preset name.
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
